queries.name: grand_totals_with_ratios
queries.purpose: Summarize the comparable business with the main current, prior, change, and ratio measures in one place for the report headline.
queries.intent: Grand totals in one row for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered to the comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across the branch-bearing tables 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], with no grouping and one row.

queries.name: new_branch_totals_cf022
queries.purpose: Show the standalone contribution of the new branch that must be separated from like-for-like performance.
queries.intent: Grand totals in one row for [net revenue CURRENT], [net qty CURRENT], and [net bills CURRENT], filtered to only branch CFH022 across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], with no prior-period percentage calculations and no grouping.

queries.name: recent_month_trend
queries.purpose: Show the most recent month-by-month comparable trend so the report can lead with the latest period.
queries.intent: Monthly trend grouped by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date], returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], and [bills growth %], filtered to comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], limited to the 15 most recent rows and sorted by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] descending.

queries.name: branch_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Identify which comparable branches are driving the group result.
queries.intent: Breakdown by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for the comparable branches only, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], limited to 15 rows and sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] descending.

queries.name: division_breakdown
queries.purpose: Summarize performance by division to show which major parts of the business are growing or shrinking.
queries.intent: Breakdown by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] for comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], with the comparable branch filter applied across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], limited to 15 rows and sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.

queries.name: product_group_breakdown
queries.purpose: Show the most important product groups by current revenue with enough metrics to explain their movement.
queries.intent: Top 15 rows grouped by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[product_group_name], returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered to comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] descending.

queries.name: category_health_summary
queries.purpose: Add the model’s category decline and revenue-share health measures needed for report-level category context.
queries.intent: Grand totals in one row for [COUNT %], [contribution cur], and [contribution past], filtered to the comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], with no grouping.

queries.name: branch_by_division_cross
queries.purpose: Show the largest branch-by-division combinations behind the comparable revenue movement.
queries.intent: Top 15 combinations grouped by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name], returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [net bills CURRENT], and derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], filtered to comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.
